Libro_4: ^"In the time of the First Embers, the King of Grace walked among us, and his word was the foundation of the world.""
^""He bound the Great Circle not with iron, but with the silken threads of concord.""
^""Under his mantle, every hearth was sacred and every tongue sang a single hymn of peace.""
^Eight hundred winters have since guarded his rest, yet the stars still reflect the crown of a Golden Age"
